title: Confirm Avro encoder adoption on the final verifier
description: Requalify the JDK heap-window guarantee through backing length 20. Prove a read-only view keeps the backing contents and advances its own cursor. Compare fresh, clean and reused wrap proofs; trace the exact view passed to both original encoders and reject the old six-byte bound for the large windows. Requalify on the final common verifier and retain the first measurement for comparison.

steps.name: Prove and qualify the shared heap-buffer facts
